canonical_project: UzCloud / UZINFOCOM national cloud network (5 sites)
notes: UzCloud officially claims 5 data centers across 4 regions, 61 modules, 299 IT racks and 5.1 MW capacity, with named sites including Akhangaran (Tashkent Region), Bukhara and Kokand (Fergana Region); operator page also claims 40 Gbps TAS-IX connectivity and GPU-as-a-Service. LinkedIn states 3 proprietary Tier III-certified DCs in Kokand, Tashkent and Bukhara. Recorded as operator-stated footprint (A for claim); per-site physical reconciliation with Uzbektelecom cloud hubs pending to avoid double counting.
